baseline_calibration_matrix.notes: Short 15m window (3 buckets). High sensitivity, fast adaptation, vulnerable to quick poisoning.
Standard 30m window (6 buckets). Balanced reference period, moderate poisoning resistance.
Long 60m window (12 buckets). Smoother baseline, higher poisoning inertia, longer cold start.
30m EWMA (alpha=0.3). Exponential recency weighting, rapidly tracks recent spikes.
30m Periodic Median. Robust to extreme outlier buckets, resist abrupt bursts.

scenario_catalog.name: Cold-Start Benign Web Browsing (35 reqs, 0 history)
scenario_catalog.description: Newly spawned client with zero prior baseline history sending 35 legitimate requests. Cold-start min_floor (40) must prevent false alerts.

scenario_catalog.name: Flash Crowd Promotional Surge (160 reqs across 16 IPs)
scenario_catalog.description: Legitimate marketing sale event with 16 distinct users each sending 10 reqs (total 160 reqs). Fixed endpoint threshold (100) false positives here.

scenario_catalog.name: Benign Socket.IO & Asset Polling Burst (95 total reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: High concurrency UI hydration burst on static assets and socket polling. Safely excluded by path filters.

scenario_catalog.name: Corporate NAT Multi-User Browsing (3 Users, 75 reqs total)
scenario_catalog.description: 3 enterprise users behind corporate NAT gateway IP 203.0.113.10 sending 25 reqs each. Source-IP threshold (60) alerts erroneously.

scenario_catalog.name: Baseline Poisoning Ramp Attack (30m ramp + 85 req burst)
scenario_catalog.description: Attacker deliberately conditions the dynamic baseline upward over 30 mins, blinding pure dynamic thresholds. Handled by hybrid fixed ceiling / rules.

scenario_catalog.name: Distributed Low-Rate Botnet (8 IPs, 160 total reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: 8 distinct residential bot nodes scraping product catalog (20 reqs/IP, under 60 threshold). Endpoint aggregation detects (160 > 100).

scenario_catalog.name: Rogue Insider Exfiltration Behind NAT (mallory 85 reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Malicious insider exfiltrating records behind corporate gateway. Endpoint aggregation alerts without attribution; hybrid identifies mallory.

scenario_catalog.name: Multi-Stage Attack Chain (Recon + SQLi + Volume)
scenario_catalog.description: Coordinated multi-vector campaign. Endpoint aggregation alone catches only volume; hybrid fusion correlates all stages into an Incident.

scenario_catalog.name: Benign Morning Traffic Shift (30m smooth ramp)
scenario_catalog.description: Legitimate shift as employees log on in the morning. Baseline adapts smoothly; volume remains below threshold. Must NOT alert.

scenario_catalog.name: Polite Search Engine Crawlers (4 Spiders, 48 reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: 4 legitimate search indexing spiders politely indexing product pages. Must NOT alert.

scenario_catalog.name: Asset Cache Invalidation Burst (55 asset reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Frontend QA engineer forcing cache invalidation on CSS bundles. Excluded from general volumetric rules.

scenario_catalog.name: Multi-Branch Office NAT (4 Branches, 80 reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: 4 regional branch offices issuing standard inventory queries. Must NOT alert.

scenario_catalog.name: Stealth Low-Rate Botnet (10 IPs, 120 total reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: 10 residential nodes scraping products at only 12 reqs/IP (undetectable by IP rules). Endpoint aggregation detects (120 > 100).

scenario_catalog.name: High Baseline Sustained Exfiltration (115 reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Attacker pre-conditions high baseline rate over 60 mins. Exceeds fixed threshold (60) and ceiling.

scenario_catalog.name: Distributed Credential Stuffing (6 IPs, 90 failed logins)
scenario_catalog.description: Coordinated distributed brute force targeting login endpoint. Handled by brute force & endpoint aggregation.

scenario_catalog.name: Multi-Stage Account Takeover Campaign
scenario_catalog.description: Full kill-chain: credential brute force -> success -> admin enumeration -> bulk exfiltration. Handled by hybrid incident correlation.

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Cold Start Microservice (28 reqs, 0 history)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: Newly added route with zero historical events. Cold start min_floor prevents false alert. Must NOT alert.

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Flash Crowd Event (18 IPs, 180 total reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: Viral promotion across 18 legitimate buyers (10 reqs each). Fixed endpoint threshold (100) false positives here.

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Enterprise Gateway (6 Users, 120 reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: 6 analysts behind enterprise egress proxy sending 20 reqs each. Source-IP rule alerts erroneously (120 > 60).

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Partner Webhook Ingestion (35 deliveries)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: B2B integration webhook traffic. Normal API volume, must NOT alert.

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Botnet Swarm (12 IPs, 180 total reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: 12 distributed botnet IPs scraping /rest/products (15 reqs/IP, well under 60). Endpoint aggregation detects (180 > 100).

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Baseline Poisoning Ramp (45m ramp + 90 reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: Attacker progressively inflates rolling baseline, testing poisoning vulnerabilities.

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Rogue Insider Exfiltration (insider_ops 75 reqs)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: Malicious insider executing data dump behind proxy. Handled with entity attribution by hybrid identity rule.

scenario_catalog.name: Held-Out Multi-Stage Cyber Attack (SQLi + Recon + Bots)
scenario_catalog.description: Held-out validation: Reconnaissance, SQL injection, and distributed botnet exfiltration. Hybrid fusion correlates into an integrated Incident.
